Questions people actually ask

Do you design a landscape from a blank page?

Not as a standalone architecture service. The company says in-house design is for renovations and enhancements, and that larger design work is done with a landscape architect.

Where do you work?

The yard address is in Pilot Point. The company names Frisco, Plano, McKinney, Denton, Prosper, Little Elm, Celina, and the surrounding North Dallas–Fort Worth area, and also says it serves clients throughout Texas.

How do I ask about a property?

Call 469-455-9733, email info@txlandscapeservices.com, or send the form on the contact page. You will get a reply from the company; this site does not promise a specific response time.

Do you only take commercial work?

No. The company’s own site and listing include residential landscaping, estate grounds, and commercial properties. A third-party directory has at times marked the profile “commercial only”; the company’s own pages list both.
